Summer Trails Projects
         •   Glacier Creek Bridge on Winner Creek Trail
Bids Opened. Project awarded to Spernak and Sons. Timeline includes pre-work in 2026, construction in 2027.

         •   Winner Creek Extension Trail:
AK Trails completed drainage work and restored pathway at entry Verbier Way.
Added sign post at each end. Signage ordered and will be installed in 2026..

         •   Chelsea’s Crossing:
Bridge complete over California Creek, connecting Crow Creek Road to Town Center.
Volunteer effort is proposed to work on the Crow Creek Road access trail timeline TBA

         •   Middle Iditarod NHT
RTP $80,000 reimbursement received. Wrap up will include reimbursement for Alaska Trails work.
AK Trails worked 2 weeks in June and 2 weeks in August.
YEP crew worked 1 week in June.
Thank you Sherry Dugan for funding YEP Crew!
Thank you Barb Crews for catering a thank-you picnic for the crew!

Focus of this years’ work is moving town valley toward the school, except for location of trail re-route for Holtan Hills.
IHTA providing grant to pay for easement on areas on Girdwood INHT that are not already in easements. Field work and survey are
complete. Documentation and filing are in process.

         •   Lower Iditarod NHT
Early season work to remove sticks and overgrowth.
Brushed in July by seasonal crew.

         •   Beaver Pond Trail
Continuation of drainage and trail tread improvements.
Alaska Trails Crew brushed the trail end of June

         •   Connector trail from Alyeska Highway to Davos Rd.
Work Party June 2026 on drainage and spreading gravel.

         •   Lower Virgin Creek Trail (from Virgin Creek Rd to Danich)
Project is trail clearing, work on establishing a single route up the hill to meet the social trail on the ridge.
Trailhead, map and signage installation when work is complete.

Sept 2026 Report
                            Girdwood Trails Committee


Updates and other business:
Girdwood Parks Master Plan was approved by P&Z Aug 10 with some minor revisions, which are being formalized.
Girdwood Valley Trails Management Plan. Current version is posted on the GTC page. Barb Crews has initiated review
of this document with the goal of updating it to match the Girdwood Trails Master Plan.
Girdwood Trails Master Plan. Adopted version is posted on the GTC page. GirdwoodTrailsPlan_February2024.pdf
Girdwood Comprehensive Plan. Final version was formally adopted in early April 2025.

Financial report: $82,616.32 as of 8/26/26. Balance does not include restricted donations.
Thank you Terri Adkins for donation via the Alaska Community Foundation.

Trail Projects: Status of GVSA Trails projects:
    •   Bridge replacement over California Creek adjacent to Town Square Park/Crow
       Creek Road funded by private donation.
      DONE!
    •   Suspension bridge to replace the Hand Tram funded by a variety of sources.
       IN PROGRESS
    •   Tread and drainage work on the Middle Iditarod National Historic Trail between
       the school and USFS Boundary co-funded by GVSA and RTP
      RTP GRANT COMPLETE with end of season 2026, completing wrap-up reporting
      and reimbursement.
        Possible project for 2027 RTP GRANT.
    •   Easements: Iditarod Historic Trail Alliance (IHTA) potential assistance in
        getting easements on the Girdwood Iditarod NHT.
       IN PROGRESS
    •    Trail work and trailhead signage on the Lower Virgin Creek Trail (a social trail that connects Virgin Creek Road
        to Danich Trail).
      PENDING

Grants Status report:
RTP 2027 grant round: Grant open now. GPR/GTC reviewing project ideas for grant.        DUE 10/31/26
Land and Water Conservation Fund (LWCF): Grant open now.                        DUE 10/30/26
Anchorage Park Foundation Challenge Grant: GTC (Kate and Barb) applied for interp signs to be installed at the new
suspension bridge.                                                                  IN PROGRESS
Alaska Community Foundation: GPR was not awarded the trail care fund grant.           NOT AWARDED
State of Alaska, Capital Budget: State awarded $1.2M for the suspension bridge project via Alaska Long Trail Funding.
Rasmuson Tier II Grant: GVSA was awarded funding for this for suspension bridge.          IN PROGRESS
Recreational Trails Program Grant (RTP): GTC did not apply for RTP in 2025. 2024 grant was awarded for the Middle
INHT. GPR is wrapping up that project scope in 2026, ongoing reimbursements.             IN PROGRESS
Dugan Family donation for trails signs on Middle Iditarod Trail and bench at the 5K parking   COMPLETE
Dugan Family donation for work on MINHT starting in 2026.                          COMPLETE

Trail Map Project: Summer map project complete and installed at the 5K. Winter map complete and will be printed
and displayed with change of season.

Trails Commercial Use Permits: Any business operating commercially on Girdwood trails should have a permit
issued locally. Contact for requesting permits is girdwoodpermits@anchorageak.gov 907-343-8373. Report operators
without permits to Kyle Kelley: kyle.kelley@anchorageak.gov 907-343-8374.
